title: Flat hunting and household problems
subtitle: L'appartement donne sur la rue ?
summary: Ask an estate agent about a flat to rent, describe a home, its rooms and its problems, and understand the words of a French tenancy.

lesson.heading: Phoning the agency
lesson.text: Boniface calls an estate agent (**l'agent immobilier**) about a flat. Start by saying why you are calling with **je téléphone à propos de ...**, then ask your questions politely.

examples.text: **Je téléphone à propos de** l'appartement à louer rue Couperin.
examples.note: I'm calling about the flat to rent in rue Couperin.

examples.text: **Je peux vous poser quelques questions ?**
examples.note: May I ask you a few questions?

examples.text: L'appartement **fait quelle surface** ? — Il fait 52 m².
examples.note: How big is the flat? - It's 52 square metres.

examples.text: **Il y a combien de pièces ?**
examples.note: How many rooms are there?

examples.text: L'appartement **donne sur** la rue ? — Non, il donne sur un petit jardin.
examples.note: Does the flat look onto the street? - No, it looks onto a small garden.

examples.text: Il est **chauffé au gaz** ou **à l'électricité** ?
examples.note: Is it heated by gas or electricity?

lesson.heading: The visit: problems and key expressions
lesson.text: The agent plays everything down; Boniface is not convinced. Use these phrases to point out problems - or to dismiss them.

examples.text: Ce n'est pas **en très bon état**...
examples.note: It's not in very good condition...

examples.text: Il faut juste **repeindre**. — Il y a plusieurs **trous** dans les murs !
examples.note: It just needs repainting. - There are several holes in the walls!

examples.text: **Ce n'est rien du tout !** / **Ce n'est pas grave.**
examples.note: It's nothing at all! / It's not serious.

examples.text: **J'entends un bruit bizarre**, un bruit de plomberie.
examples.note: I can hear a strange noise, a plumbing noise.

examples.text: **Le loyer est de combien ?** — 770 euros.
examples.note: How much is the rent? - 770 euros.

examples.text: **Non merci !** **En plus**, il n'y a pas assez de place.
examples.note: No thanks! What's more, there isn't enough room.

lesson.heading: The rooms and what's in them
rows: un lave-vaisselle, un lave-linge (dishwasher, washing machine)
lesson.note: Flats are named by their number of rooms: **un studio**, **un deux-pièces**, **un trois-pièces** ... The kitchen and the bathroom are not counted.

lesson.heading: Describing a flat
rows: in the town centre ≠ on the outskirts

lesson.heading: Les petits problèmes
lesson.text: Old flats come with small problems. Learn to name them - and **il faut** + infinitive to say what needs doing.

examples.text: Les robinets **fuient**. Il y a **une fuite** d'eau.
examples.note: The taps are leaking. There's a water leak.

examples.text: Il y a des trous dans le mur. **Il faut repeindre** les murs.
examples.note: There are holes in the wall. The walls need repainting.

examples.text: Il faut changer **la moquette**.
examples.note: The carpet needs changing.

examples.text: Une fenêtre est **cassée**. Une porte **ferme mal**.
examples.note: A window is broken. A door doesn't close properly.

examples.text: Le loyer est **hors de prix** !
examples.note: The rent is outrageously expensive!

lesson.heading: Renting a flat
lesson.text: **Louer** works both ways: the owner rents a flat out, and the tenant rents it. The tenant pays **le loyer** every month. When you move in, you sign **un bail** (a lease) and pay **une caution** (a deposit, usually one month's rent) - sometimes agency fees too.

examples.text: **Le propriétaire** loue un appartement **au locataire**.
examples.note: The owner rents a flat to the tenant.

examples.text: Le loyer est de 550 euros, **charges comprises**.
examples.note: The rent is 550 euros, service charges included.

examples.text: **les frais d'agence**
examples.note: agency fees

examples.text: **passer un coup de fil** = téléphoner à quelqu'un
examples.note: to make a phone call (familiar)

lesson.text: About 64% of French people own their home, most of them in the countryside, and housing (rent, heating, electricity, upkeep) takes about 24% of the household budget.

exercises.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.

context.label: From the dialogue
context.text:
*Boniface :* L'appartement fait quelle surface, exactement ?
*L'agent immobilier :* Il fait 52 m². C'est un bel appartement récent.

exercises.explanation: The agent says it is **récent** - recently built.

context.label: From the dialogue
context.text:
*Boniface :* L'appartement donne sur la rue ?
*L'agent immobilier :* Non, il donne sur un petit jardin. C'est charmant et très calme...

exercises.explanation: It **donne sur un petit jardin** - it looks onto a small garden.

context.label: From the dialogue
context.text: *Boniface :* Oui, c'est très calme, mais c'est sombre. Et moi, j'ai absolument besoin de lumière !

exercises.explanation: Boniface finds it **sombre** (dark) - the opposite of *clair*.

context.label: From the dialogue
context.text: *Boniface :* 770 euros pour un appartement en mauvais état, non merci ! En plus, il n'y a pas assez de place et trop de problèmes ici !

exercises.prompt: Why does Boniface turn the flat down?
options: It's in bad condition, too small and has too many problems for 770 euros.
It's too far from the town centre.
It's too noisy because it looks onto the street.
The agent refuses to repaint it.
exercises.explanation: **En mauvais état**, **pas assez de place**, **trop de problèmes** - not worth 770 euros.

exercises.prompt: Who is speaking: the client or the estate agent?

items.text: J'entends un petit bruit de plomberie...
Il faut juste repeindre un peu...

exercises.explanation: **Un bruit** = a noise. *J'entends un bruit bizarre* - I can hear a strange noise.

exercises.prompt: Il y a un petit problème d'électricité, mais ce n'est pas ___.
exercises.explanation: **Ce n'est pas grave** - it's not serious.

exercises.prompt: — Il y a de gros problèmes de plomberie ! — Mais non, ce n'est ___ !
exercises.explanation: **Ce n'est rien (du tout) !** - It's nothing (at all)!

exercises.prompt: Choose the right words: *Je téléphone ___ la maison à louer.*
exercises.explanation: **Je téléphone à propos de ...** - I'm calling about ...

exercises.statement: « L'appartement est hors de prix » veut dire « il n'est pas cher ».

exercises.prompt: Build the polite question: "May I ask you a few questions?"
exercises.answer: Je peux vous poser quelques questions ?
exercises.explanation: **Je peux** + **vous** + infinitive: the pronoun goes before *poser*.
